appDesc.message: Save images via click, drag or bulk download.

disableDragLabel.description: Label for the checkbox to turn off drag-to-save.

optionsStatus.description: Status message shown when options are saved.

popupSelect.description: Tooltip for the checkbox to select a media cell.

popupDeselect.description: Tooltip for the checkbox to deselect a media cell.

popupDownload.description: Action button tooltip for downloading a specific image.

popupLoading.description: Message shown while scanning the page for media.

popupNoMedia.description: Message shown when no images or videos are found.

popupVideos.description: Header for the video section in the popup.

popupDownloadSelected.description: Button label for downloading only the selected media.

popupDownloadAll.description: Button label for downloading all captured media.

popupReload.message: Reload the page and try again
popupReload.description: Message shown when an error occurs and the page needs to be reloaded.

popupMediaFallback.description: Fallback name for an image/video when the URL has no filename.

popupDerivedBadge.description: Badge aria-label indicating an image was generated from an inline SVG.

popupDerivedBadgeText.description: Short visible badge text indicating an image is an SVG.

popupEmptyHint.message: Tip: Alt+Click or drag images to save directly
popupEmptyHint.description: Hint shown to users on how to save images directly.

popupInlineSvg.description: Filename shown in the cell label for a captured inline SVG. Must match the real download filename in background.js — do not translate.

popupHiddenCount.description: Message showing the number of smaller duplicate images collapsed from the UI.

popupShortcutHint.description: Instructions on keyboard shortcuts shown in button tooltips.

popupSelectedOne.description: Selection counter, singular plural form. $COUNT$ is the number of selected items; it is not always literally 1 — the form is chosen by Intl.PluralRules for the UI language.

popupSelectedOther.description: Noun following the count of selected images (plural).

popupDownloadSelectedCount.description: Button label for downloading only the selected media, with count.

popupDownloadAllCount.description: Button label for downloading all captured media, with count.

popupDownloadFile.description: Action button tooltip for downloading a specific image with its filename.

popupSelectFile.description: Tooltip for the checkbox to select a media cell, with the filename.

popupDeselectFile.description: Tooltip for the checkbox to deselect a media cell, with the filename.
